text: あなたは　どこから　きて　どこへ　ゆくの？

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. きて = 'come, and'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a soft casual question, used instead of か. ゆくの？ = 'are you going?'.
